note: A5.4. Two proto packages (billing, legacy) declare the same `service PaymentsService`; the Go storefront imports only `pb "example.com/gen/billing"`. Before A5.4 the bare client key pairs with BOTH services, so the forbid row fires. After it the client's package evidence (its import paths, carried on an RPC_PACKAGE cell) matches billing's go_package and nothing of legacy's, so exactly one GRPC_CALLS edge survives. The client qname stays bare: qualification is an edge decision taken in the resolver, not a qname shape change. Cell binding go/grpc only: `proto` is not one of the 16 language rows.
